## Change

Describe the user-visible change and version.

## Validation

- [ ] Scoped lint, format and tests pass.
- [ ] The application builds.
- [ ] Relevant phone-width and desktop behavior is checked.
- [ ] The changelog reflects the version.
- [ ] No environment values, credentials or internal project documents are included.

## Version evidence

Include the branch, commit, preview and verification results. State checks that were not executed.
